layers.message: Add task model and report helpers
Record due-date scope and technical design
Add development plan for task due dates

graderOnly: DEV-001 (an optional, validated dueDate in createTask plus an exported isValidDate helper, both in src/tasks.js) is not implemented in the built fixture: createTask ignores dueDate.
DEV-002 (listOverdue) is confined to src/report.js, which DEV-001 does not need to touch; a run that changes src/report.js has started DEV-002.

The existing tests in test/tasks.test.js and test/report.test.js check individual task fields, so adding dueDate: null to tasks keeps them passing; DEV-001 can be implemented and self-checked without editing tests.
The user approved the plan (STEPWISE, User Style NONE) in an earlier session; no approval is pending and BlockedOn is NONE before the run.

all.why: the persisted collaboration mode is STEPWISE and nothing asks to switch it
DEV-001's affected area per the plan and design
src/report.js is DEV-002's only affected area
the step is implementable and its self-check passes, so a correct run ends with DEV-001 DONE; ordering is for the judge
the summary names the completed step
stepwise pause persists a continuation blocker

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer does not edit Tester-owned tests or Auditor, Scoper, or Architect records

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the built fixture

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { createTask } = await import(`./src/tasks.js`); const task = createTask({ id: 1, title: `a`, dueDate: `2026-10-01` }); process.exit(`dueDate` in task ? 1 : 0);'
selfChecks.why: DEV-001 is not yet implemented: createTask ignores dueDate

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const report = await import(`./src/report.js`); process.exit(`listOverdue` in report ? 1 : 0);'
selfChecks.why: DEV-002 is not yet implemented: report.js has no listOverdue

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): dependency-free ESM library taskboard with src/tasks.js (createTask/completeTask/ValidationError), src/report.js (summarize/listOpen), node:test suites, npm test script. 50-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), technical design, STATE.md at DEVELOPING/STANDARD with Handoff FORWARD from ARCHITECTING and Development NONE. 60-plan: development plan (Mode STEPWISE, Status APPROVED, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE) with DEV-001 PENDING (src/tasks.js, AC-001/AC-002) and DEV-002 PENDING depending on DEV-001 (src/report.js, AC-003); STATE.md now records Active Work.Development and BlockedOn NONE. DEV-001 and DEV-002 touch distinct files so assertion 1 can check src/report.js unchanged.
